[HCM] GenAI Engineer (Senior)

Synthetic Labs Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam

ABOUT THE ROLE:

You will build and ship GenAI applications (LLM, RAG, agents) for clients, from prototype to production.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Build LLM applications: RAG pipelines and tool calling.
  • Evaluate quality with clear metrics.

REQUIREMENTS:

  • 2+ years of hands-on AI/ML engineering experience, including LLM applications in production.
  • Strong Python; experience with frameworks such as LangChain/LangGraph, LlamaIndex, MCP or similar.
  • Experience with vector databases (Qdrant, pgvector, Milvus...) and RAG design.
  • Able to show results: evaluation metrics, users served, latency or cost improvements.
  • Good spoken English for daily work with clients.
  • Bachelor's degree in CS, AI, Data Science or a related field.

NICE TO HAVE:

  • Fine-tuning (LoRA/QLoRA), self-hosted LLMs (vLLM), LLMOps.
  • Cloud deployment (AWS/Azure/GCP), Docker/Kubernetes, CI/CD.

Please note: profiles that are mainly data engineering or data analysis will not match.

BENEFIT:

  • 13th-month salary and performance bonus.
  • 2 days WFH/week.
